mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y-o-y GDPC1 growth accelerates by > 2pp but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the ISM manufacturing index (proxied by INDPRO) falls below 50, indicating a contraction in manufacturing activity, it signals an impending economic slowdown that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO falls below 50 but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate, defined as a 0.5 percentage point rise over the past 3 months, signals a rapidly weakening labor market that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE rises > 0.5pp in 3 months but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 55% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 5%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy that will slow economic growth and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS exceeds 5% but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in > 40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (proxied by HOUST) decline by more than 10% year-over-year, it signals a weakening housing market that will drag on economic growth and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y-o-y HOUST growth falls by > 10% but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in > 50% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is above 6% and rising, it signals a weakening labor market that will slow consumer spending and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE > 6% and rising, but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 55% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) is above its 12-month moving average and accelerating, it signals a strengthening manufacturing sector that will boost economic growth and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO > 12-mo MA and accelerating, but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 2% and falling, it signals an accommodative monetary policy that will stimulate economic growth and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS < 2% and falling, but SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances.
